PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 19, 2026
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER
  BRIDGE ROOM, 9:00 AM

Susan Redfield, Chair  Sharleen Higa, Commissioner
Silissa Uriarte Smith, Vice Chair  Robert Livingstone, Commissioner
Cory Allen, Commissioner  Kasey Schoen, Commissioner
Christopher Chavez, Commissioner

Stephen Scott, Director
Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  christine.amaya@longbeach.gov

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 PRESENTATIONS

 Employee(s) of the Month

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-54342  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Parks and Recreation
  Commission meeting of Thursday, February 19, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  26-54485  Recommend to the Government Operations and Efficiency Committee to rename
  the Central Facilities Center at Martin Luther King Jr. Park to the Dale Clinton
  Facilities Center. (District 6)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  26-54343  Recommendation to consider approval of the fee waiver requests outlined in
  Attachment “A” in accordance with the Fee Waiver policy.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  26-54564  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine, or
  management designee, to execute the Personal Services and Instruction
  Agreements and amend Attachment "A" of the agreements as needed.

  Page 1 of 4
   PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 19, 2026
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER
  BRIDGE ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54483  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  execute a non-exclusive Revocable Use Permit with Long Beach Lawn Bowling
  Club, Inc., a California nonprofit corporation, for the use and operation of the Long
  Beach Lawn Bowling buildings and greens for a term of three years, with two,
  three-year renewal options, at the discretion of the Director. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54484  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  approve the replacement of a storage container at Heartwell Park, and to issue all
  documents necessary for a Right-of-Entry Permit to Long Beach Heartwell
  Fastpitch, a California nonprofit, from April 1, 2026, to March 31, 2027, with the
  option to extend for one (1) additional one-year term at the discretion of the
  Director. (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54481  Recommendation to receive and file the Director’s monthly highlights report, “We
  Create Community” and “Director’s Highlights” for March 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-54482  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Parks and
  Recreation Commission meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker
is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Christine Amaya, Administrative Aide, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Parks, Recreation and Marine Administration

NOTE:

If oral language interpretation for non-English speaking persons is desired or if a special
accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, please make your request
by phone to the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101, 24 business hours prior to the Charter
Commission meeting.

Kung nais ang interpretasyon ng sinasalitang wika para sa mga taong hindi nagsasalita ng Ingles o
kung nais ang isang natatanging tulong ayon sa Americans with Disabilities Act, mangyaring
isagawa ang iyong hiling sa pamamagitan ng telepono sa Opisina ng Clerk ng Lungsod sa (562)
570-6101, 24 oras ng negosyo bago ang pagpupulong ng Charter Commission.

Si desea interpretación oral en otro idioma para personas que no hablan inglés o si desea una
adaptación especial en conformidad con la Ley de Estadounidenses con Discapacidades, haga su
solicitud por teléfono a la Oficina de la Secretaría Municipal al (562) 570-6101, 24 horas hábiles
antes de la reunión de la comisión de estatutos.

If written language translation of the Commission agenda and minutes for non-English speaking
persons is desired, please make your request by phone to the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-
6101, 72 business hours prior to the Commission meeting.

Kung nais ang pagsasalin ng nakasulat na wika ng agenda ng Komisyon at ang minutes para sa
mga taong hindi nagsasalita ng Ingles, mangyaring isagawa ang iyong hiling sa pamamagitan ng

pagpupulong ng Commission.

Si desea obtener la traducción escrita en otro idioma de la agenda y actas de la comisión para
personas que no hablan inglés, haga su solicitud por teléfono a la Oficina de la Secretaría Municipal
al (562) 570-6101, 72 horas hábiles antes de la reunión de la comisión.
